findings.issue: Delayed options resolve to valid available choices, but admission rejects optionsMode=loading. Loading must remain transport delay consistently.

Uncertain committed submission retry re-preflights/rebuilds the request and may never replay the original receipt lookup after eligibility changes; it can also incorrectly clear uncertainty. Preserve and replay immutable original body/key and permit recovery independently of current eligibility reads.
Numeric Literal[1] accepts/coerces JSON true despite strict=True, while generated Zod rejects it. Reject boolean numeric constants before coercion and preserve exported constant schema semantics.

Uncertain replay remains locked even after the mock returns a definitive no-admission result after receipt lookup. Clear uncertainty for confirmed no-admission outcomes while preserving ambiguous failures.
